tables.description: Read-only native sync from existing schedules view. Collector does not write source fields.

fields.name: Category
fields.description: global: base guidance, rules and work management; data: entities, relationships, settings and reference records; runtime: input/event processing records, including prepared tables; deprecated: ___ retained legacy tables. Category describes purpose, not whether code or automation is connected.

fields.name: Purpose
fields.description: Agreed role and consolidation history; prepared structure does not imply runtime connection.

fields.name: Table link
fields.description: Direct link to the actual table using its stable ID.

tables.name: people
tables.description: Consolidated people directory: six existing user fixtures retained; 117 contact identities and seven unmatched groom/exerciser identities imported. Eight unambiguous contact/groom pairs combined by explicit existing links. Roles are descriptive, not permissions; memberships carry tenant relationships. Source links retain all history and external references. Riders/trainers remain shared masters. Review notes identify uncertain names/conflicting links; no Recognize identity guessed or access activated. Runtime cutover is separate.

fields.name: Roles
fields.description: Descriptive source roles; never grants tenant access or consent.

fields.name: Associated horses
fields.description: Preserved source associations, not an authorization grant.

fields.name: Rider
fields.description: Exact legacy rider ID mapping only; shared rider master remains separate.

fields.name: display-name
fields.description: User-selected display name for this Person. Does not change recognition identity or permissions.

fields.name: profile-img
fields.description: Profile image URL for this Person; no credential or access meaning.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Comma-separated descriptive user tags; never grants access or consent.

tables.name: sources
tables.description: Entities source table prepared from existing Recognize data. Existing field names and stable application IDs retained for compatibility. Runtime cutover and sharing are pending; do not treat this staged copy as the active writer yet.

tables.name: events
tables.description: Entities source table prepared from existing Recognize data. Existing field names and stable application IDs retained for compatibility. Runtime cutover and sharing are pending; do not treat this staged copy as the active writer yet.

tables.name: optins
tables.description: Individual notification consent and scope, reused from subscriptions. Existing consent, status, phone, IDs and preferences_json retained. optin-options makes choices/timings readable; favorites is separate. No activation or runtime routing change; revoked consent remains revoked.

fields.name: Membership
fields.description: Recipient membership: exactly one tenant/person context. Required before activation; blank copied records remain unresolved. Groom scope uses active tenant-assignments for this membership.

fields.name: Managed by
fields.description: Person managing these options. For owner-managed groom settings, resolve this Person to an Enabled owner membership in the recipient Membership's tenant before accepting changes. Does not grant consent; preserve recipient consent_state and revoked_at.

fields.name: Selected favorites
fields.description: Selected favorites must belong to this same Membership. Never merge another tenant's favorites.

tables.name: tenant-roster
tables.description: Tenant-specific horse/rider roster and owner exclusions, independent of week/day participation. One tenant plus exactly one Horse or Rider per record. Trainer association identifies roster source; an Additional association may supply horses only. Disabled overrides inclusion in this tenant, never changes shared global inactive flags. Prepared structure; enforcement remains application work.

fields.name: Tenant
fields.description: Exactly one tenant; must match source Trainer association.

fields.name: Horse
fields.description: Set Horse OR Rider, never both.

fields.name: Rider
fields.description: Set Rider OR Horse, never both. Additional trainer riders are excluded.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Tenant-local owner decision. Blank is unclassified; never inferred from current entries.

fields.name: Trainer association
fields.description: Source tenant-trainer association(s). Must match Tenant; riders require Primary, never Additional. More than one source may justify the same horse, without duplicating its roster row.

tables.name: tenant-trainers
tables.description: One trainer association per tenant. Primary imports that trainer's horses and riders; Additional imports horses only, never riders. Explicit tenant-roster status controls exclusions. Membership/access and show entries remain separate. Structure prepared; no application processor or access activated.

fields.name: Tenant
fields.description: Exactly one tenant.

fields.name: Trainer
fields.description: Exactly one shared trainer.

fields.name: Association
fields.description: Primary: horses and riders. Additional: horses only. Never infer policy from shared trainer records.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Applies only to this tenant association. Blank is unclassified, not enabled.

tables.name: tenant-assignments
tables.description: Staff/groom assignment within one tenant membership. Each record assigns one horse to one membership; tenant derives from Membership.Tenant, so no duplicate tenant field. Staff may also be riders; groom visibility is limited to active assignments. Never infer assignment/access from people.Associated horses. Structure only; no runtime access activated.

fields.name: Membership
fields.description: Exactly one staff/groom membership; supplies tenant, person and tenant-specific roles.

fields.name: Horse
fields.description: Exactly one horse within the membership tenant's enabled roster.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Only Active assignments apply; ended rows retain assignment history. Blank is not active.

tables.name: optin-options
tables.description: Readable individual alert choices for an opt-in: one option key, on/off and optional timing/value per row. Preferences JSON retained as compatibility source until verified cutover. Options never override revoked consent. No delivery automation enabled.

tables.name: favorites
tables.description: Personal follow list within a tenant membership; separate from tenant-wide roster. Exactly one Horse, Rider or Trainer target per row; this rule requires application validation. No access or notification delivery granted by following.
